m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
m.setup(glob.glob(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(np.__file__),'..','numpy.libs','*openblas*'))[0], "scipy_dgeev_64_")
rng=np.random.default_rng(11)
for n in (6,8,10):
    As=[rng.normal(size=(n,n)) for _ in range(50)]
    out=[]
    for ph,nm in ((1,"norseid"),(2,"no-qr"),(3,"no-eigv")):
        m.set_phase(ph)
        t=min(timeit.repeat(lambda: [m.dom_eig(A) for A in As], number=20, repeat=7))/(20*50)
        out.append(f"{nm}={t*1e6:5.2f}")
    m.set_phase(0)
    t=min(timeit.repeat(lambda: [m.dom_eig(A) for A in As], number=20, repeat=7))/(20*50)
    out.append(f"full={t*1e6:5.2f}")
    t=min(timeit.repeat(lambda: [m.dom_eig_lapack(A) for A in As], number=20, repeat=7))/(20*50)
    out.append(f"lapack={t*1e6:5.2f}")
    print(f"n={n}: " + "  ".join(out))
